interaction: Drag furniture (or tap + / −) into an SVG truck whose 12×4 cargo grid snaps items into free, supported cells — heavy items stay on the floor, and items can be dragged back out to unload. A fill bar and readout recommend a 4.5 t, 6 t or 10 t truck, the number of movers, hours and a price range at sample rates (all illustrative). Presets load typical homes, the truck physically lengthens as it upsizes, and 'Request this quote' ends in a demo toast. Also: a saved moving-day checklist and a quote form that can attach the estimate.
notes: On phones the truck is filled with steppers only (no drag), with a docked fill bar while the list is on screen. Estimates use a simple packing model and sample hourly rates.
